description: This file is a PHP script for editing execution notes and custom fields within the TestLink test management tool. It handles user input, permissions, and updates related to test execution records.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates the execution notes and custom fields in the database when the form is submitted.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters related to execution editing.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI data structure for the editing interface, including rights verification.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permissions to view and edit execution notes.
